diagnosis: The Remix action server function deletes organizations by params.orgId. While it requires a valid user session, it never validates that user.id is the registered owner or administrator of orgId, permitting any logged-in user to delete arbitrary organizations and all their associated data.

POST /organizations/org_acme_corp_01/delete HTTP/1.1
Host: app.saashub.com

_method=delete
